posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
FYI for Canadians (or perhaps other internationals) - if you order multiple copies, the shipping price per copy goes way down. For me, the shipping on one copy is $34. So far I've gotten 4 other locals together, and for 5 copies the shipping price per copy is just $12.

Apparently that's the shipping price the Americans are bitching about, but I'm pretty happy about it =)

In case you're wondering, Paul said in the post comments: "You get 1 sets of bonus things per copy of Wrath of the Cosmos you order, so feel free to consolidate!"

posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked: Definitely feel free to consolidate! In fact, we specifically *encourage* consolidation on this preorder since it will save you so much on shipping. One of the big advantages of doing a preorder through our website instead of a Kickstarter campaign is that we can calculate actual shipping for a package of any weight, so consolidations are easy (unlike on Kickstarter, where they are so complicated as to be unworkable).
